verdict.rationale: Format compatibility across runtime upgrades is a fair question for a quantized-model inference runtime like llama.cpp, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack only lists quantization bit-widths (gh-8) and the GGUF models used in examples. Nothing documents format versioning, backward-compatibility guarantees, or whether upgrades can invalidate previously downloaded quantized files.

support.subject: As a developer, I know whether upgrading the runtime can break compatibility with previously downloaded quantized model files
